Get Free API Key at Google AI Studio ↗
How to get your free API key
1. Tap the button above to open Google AI Studio.
2. Sign in with Google and click \"Create API key\".
3. Copy the key, paste it here, and tap Save.
This app operates without any intermediate server. Your text and API key go directly from your device to Google Gemini. Nobody else can access your data.
